Drive sharpens which action they choose, and Composure sharpens whom they target. Stats also feed straight into Combat Stats — Drive raises ATK·SPD, Endurance HP·DEF, Composure DEF·Accuracy·Evasion·Skill Success, Willpower ATK·Skill Resist·less Crit Damage taken, and Genius Crit Rate·Crit Damage·Ult Gauge. Teamwork raises the whole team's ATK·DEF·HP·SPD by the team average. A low Stat can even subtract, so building only one side costs you on the other. When the Ult Gauge is full, the Ult goes first.
